name: AI Agent with Anysite Unlimited MCP

parameters.content:
# n8n AI Agent + AnySite MCP

> Connect your AI agent to 68 tools for extracting data from LinkedIn, Instagram, Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, SEC, and more

## What You Get

- AI agent with access to 68 data extraction tools
- Unlimited requests for $30/month
- Simple chat interface for research

---

## Setup

### 1. AnySite

1. Sign up at [anysite.io](https://anysite.io)
2. Subscribe to **MCP Unlimited** ($30/mo) at [app.anysite.io](https://app.anysite.io)
3. Go to **MCP Server Integration** section
4. Copy your **Direct URL**:
   ```
   https://mcp.anysite.io/mcp?api_key=YOUR_API_KEY
   ```

### 2. OpenAI

1. Get API key at [platform.openai.com](https://platform.openai.com)
2. In n8n, create an **OpenAI API** credential

### 3. n8n

1. Import the workflow from JSON file
2. Configure credentials:

| Node | Credential |
|------|------------|
| AI Agent | OpenAI API |
| MCP Client | AnySite Direct URL |

---

## Test It

```

```

```

```

## Available Tools (68 total)

| Platform | Tools | What You Can Do |
|----------|-------|-----------------|
| LinkedIn | 27 | Profiles, companies, posts, employees, jobs, messaging |
| Instagram | 8 | Profiles, posts, reels, comments, likes, followers |
| Twitter/X | 5 | Profiles, tweets, user search, post search |
| Y Combinator | 3 | Companies, founders, startup search |
| YouTube | 3 | Video search, video details, subtitles |
| Reddit | 3 | Posts, comments, subreddit search |
| SEC | 2 | Company filings, document retrieval |
| Web Parser | 2 | Webpage parsing, sitemap extraction |
| Web Search | 1 | DuckDuckGo search |
